descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S17 「级别边界：最简短的记录也照样给代码，系列里每个级别上代码和级别都一致」 Level edges: a code is still shown for a minimal note, and code and level agree at every level of the family

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U10 The code and the stated level agree ('99232 / Low complexity' fails).（UAT TC-18；TFA-92596 AC 7） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U6 A code is always shown, with the elements (Problem, Data, Risk) and the quotes from the note underneath, presented as a suggestion for the physician to verify. …（UAT TC-18；TFA-92596 AC 6） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U4 The final generated note is the source of truth; the model only suggests the level within the family the template fixed.（UAT TC-18；TFA-92596 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U1 The code family is a fixed table keyed on the template, never chosen by the model: H&P and Consult -> 99221-99223 (some commercial payers accept 99252-99255); SOAP progress -> 99231-99233; …（UAT TC-18；TFA-92596 AC 1；TFA-92596 What (template -> family table)） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Notes written to land at the low and high ends of the SOAP progress, H&P and SNF follow-up families, including a two-line note

When Run the billing step once per note

Then Every note gets exactly one code from its family whose stated level matches the code; the minimal note still gets a code with unsupported elements left out

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：levelMatchesCode with the Q2 table; codeIn family; quotesInNote; minQuotes 1 except on the minimal notes h1 / h5 (Q12); noReasoning. Which level is clinically right is not judged here (Q13), but two record-only checks line up with Run 7's 'level too narrow' point (99232 on 19 of 21 hospital follow-ups): levelOrder (h3 above h2 and h1, h6 above h5) and a per-family code histogr …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S17 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-18.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AICHECK · AI 输出检查；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
